'''[[Mayene]]''' is a tiny nation bordering the [[Sea of Storms]] and entirely surrounded on the other three sides by its larger neighbor [[Tear]]. Tear's desire to absorb Mayene (and its valuable [[oilfish]] shoals) is long-standing, and only held off by the skillful political maneuvering of its [[First of Mayene|leaders]].
